seo.title: Hammond Construction – Builders in Buckinghamshire & Oxfordshire
seo.description: Family owned building, refurbishment and electrical services. Extensions, conversions, kitchens and bathrooms.

hero.lead: Hammond Construction is a family owned building, refurbishment and electrical services company. Extensions, conversions, kitchens and bathrooms, with all the trades under one roof.
hero.image_alt: House extension being built in brick

heading: Every trade,
one team.
services.intro: From a new extension to a full refurbishment, we plan the job with you and see it through to the finish.

items.title: Extensions
items.text: Single and two storey extensions, planned and built from the ground up.
items.image_alt: Extension under construction with steel beams

items.title: Kitchens
items.text: Kitchen design and installation, including worktops and tiling.

items.title: Bathrooms & wet rooms
items.text: Bathroom refits, en-suites, wet rooms and accessible showers.

items.title: Conversions
items.text: Garage and loft conversions that add space without moving.

items.title: Electrical work
items.text: Rewires, fuse boards, testing and EV charging points.

items.title: Heating
items.text: Boiler installs, servicing, radiators and underfloor heating.

steps.text: Call, or send the quote form with a few details. Photos help.

steps.text: We talk it through, look at the job and give you a clear quote.

steps.title: Job done properly
steps.text: The work is done with care and the site left clean and tidy.

quote.intro: Three quick steps and we’ll get back to you.

faqs.a: Yes. Hammond Construction is a Which? Trusted Trader, and you can read all our customer reviews on our Which? page.

faqs.q: Do you do the electrics too?
faqs.a: Yes. We’re NICEIC approved electrical contractors, so we can take care of the electrics as part of your project.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Use the quote form on this page or call 01494 483924. A few photos of the job help us give you an accurate price.
